blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — Deputy House Speaker and Bacolod Rep. Alfredo Abelardo Benitez has endorsed a shift to electric vehicles as part of efforts to reduce the country’s dependence on petroleum, improve local air quality, and lower long-term operating and maintenance costs for transport operators. Benitez stressed this in a video message at the 2026 Bacolod Electric Vehicle Summit organized by his office at Ayala Malls Capitol Central here, which opened Monday and runs until Friday, Oct. 30. “With the right infrastructure, financing, government and private sector partnerships, we can make electric mobility more accessible to our drivers and operators, while keeping […]...
